notes: A new native identifier is not a newly eligible study; cross-database overlap and modified representations remain possible.
The 95 filtered CENTRAL records are a nested subset of the 97 additions established from the complete-query comparison.
The PubMed357 flag is explicitly tied to the saved nominal list; it is not silently generalized to all identifiers absent from the September export.
Route categories count representations with a dedicated update card versus an existing-master route; prior links attached to a card are not counted twice.
recommended_table_s1_caption: Source-specific new identifier and candidate subsets and their recorded routes
recommended_table_s1_note: PubMed uses the saved nominal list of 357 identifiers new to the cross-database master at the update stage; another 14 IDs absent from the historical PubMed export were already represented in the master by the same publication PMID. Embase, PsycINFO and complete-query CENTRAL rows use native-ID differences against their own historical exports. The 95 filtered CENTRAL additions form a subset of the 97 complete-query additions. Counts are overlapping database representations, not eligible studies.
